evidence_items.explanation: The authority required tools for correcting inaccurately generated personal data, or erasing those data when correction was technically infeasible, with compliance due by 30 April. This is material counterevidence to a claim of no enforceable accuracy-related obligations, but does not establish a requirement to solve general truthfulness.
